class.name: InputSwapAxis
class.brief_description: Routes the two components of a binding.
class.description: Use on a Vector or Motion binding to change which source component becomes X or Y. The default swaps the source axes. Values and units are preserved.

members.member: Output component order. X then Y keeps the original order. Y then X exchanges the components.

constants.constant: Output X uses source X. Output Y uses source Y.
Output X uses source Y. Output Y uses source X.
